detail.longDescription: Startup Fortune: arXiv now limits every researcher to two paper submissions a month. “ArXiv capped every submitter to two papers per calendar month starting October 1, 2026, with a three-submission active ceiling, a direct response to a flood of AI-generated papers overwhelming its volunteer moderators.
